text: The pipe %>% comes from magrittr and is re-exported by dplyr; load the package with library(dplyr) in each new R session. R 4.1+ also has the native pipe |>.
'object not found' usually means the object was never created in the current session, or its name is misspelled.
A factor stores categories with levels; summary() of a factor shows counts per level, not a mean.
Map a variable to colour inside aes(); set a fixed colour outside aes().
jsonlite::fromJSON() can simplify JSON to data frames; nested fields may need flatten = TRUE.
mean() returns NA if any value is missing unless na.rm = TRUE.
In lm(), a slope coefficient is the predicted change in the outcome for a one-unit increase in a predictor; R-squared is the share of variance explained.
penguins (Palmer Archipelago) ships with base R 4.5.0+ in datasets, and in the CC0 palmerpenguins package for older R.
